minutes_text:
City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  MINUTES
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  December 07, 2020

A meeting of the Claims Review Committee was a call In Meeting at 1+ (669) 900-6833; Meeting  ID:
948 9589 3977 Passcode: 480661 at 9:38 am.

  Members Present:  Maria Heaney, Finance Department
  Derald Brenneman City Attorney’s Office
  Yonne Horton, City Clerk’s Office

  Staff Present:  Sabrina Barnes, Parks and Recreation
  Ana Ma, Police Department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Maria Heaney reported no public comments.

1. The minutes of November 23, 2020, meeting was approved as recorded.

2. Waterline Technologies, Inc. – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  maintenance and repair for the pools at Vincent Park in the amount of $1,386.00. Motion carried
  unanimously.

3. Stuart Allen Art Services – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing
  services and maintenance for the City’s Public Art Education Project in the amount of $525.00.
  Motion carried unanimously.

4. Watson – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing repair services for the
  Police Departments Communication Center in the amount of $907.94. Motion carried unanimously.

5. Word Processing Unlimited – Executive session to discuss recommended payment for
  transcription services provided to the Inglewood Police Department in the amount of $1,768.32.
  Motion carried unanimously.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Maria Heaney reported no public comments. There being no further business, the meeting adjourned
at 9:54 a.m. Adjournment
